cite.title: Admin SDK Reports API: activities resource

admin-user-settings.title: Reports API: admin application, user settings events

event_name.format: A lower-case, underscore-separated name for a login or drive event; an upper-case, underscore-separated name for most admin console events.

login_failure.meaning: A login attempt was unsuccessful; the parameters name the reason and the credential type tried.

UNENROLL_USER_FROM_STRONG_AUTH.meaning: An admin removed a user's enrollment in 2-Step Verification.

change_user_access.meaning: A file or folder's sharing permissions changed for one user, from one access level to another.

application_name.format: One fixed word naming the Reports API application the event belongs to.

event_type.format: A category within the application; login and drive share the application's own name, admin varies by the console area changed.

examples.note: on gws:reports:admin, an account security change
on gws:reports:drive, a sharing permission change
